Subject: New customer onboarding - PO needed and line item split

Hi Soojin,

We're ready to start onboarding and need a PO issued to Lakeshore Technologies. I've attached our completed onboarding form and a first-pass invoice (onboarding + implementation services). Two asks:

- Can you issue a single provisional PO but split line items between "Professional Services" and "Platform Subscription" (we need separate GL mapping on our side)?
- For the first two weeks of onboarding we expect higher spend — can you provisionally set a temporary spend cap of $75,000 while the account is in active rollout? We'll ask AP to route payments to the serial PO once finalized.

Attachments: lakeshore_onboarding_form.pdf (completed), invoice_draft.xlsx (line-level draft)

Let me know if you need any more fields filled out on the form. We can sign electronically if that's easier.

Thanks,

- Deal id: LKS-2026-104 (enterprise onboarding package).
- Recommend one PO but with two explicit line items:

  2) Platform Subscription — recurring (monthly)
